commands.command: /usr/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' /codex-home/skills/haprepair-openharmony-repair/references/operations.md"
/usr/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' /codex-home/skills/haprepair-openharmony-repair/SKILL.md"
/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '{keys:keys, first:(.entity_repairs[0]|keys), count:(.entity_repairs|length), statuses:([.entity_repairs[].status]|unique)}' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '.entity_repairs[] | select((.owning_entities|length)==0 or (.applicable_invariants|length)==0 or (.repository_evidence|length)==0) | [.rule,.relative_path] | @tsv' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json | sed -n '1,20p'"
/usr/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' /codex-home/skills/haprepair-openharmony-repair/SKILL.md"
/usr/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,300p' /codex-home/skills/haprepair-openharmony-repair/references/operations.md"
/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '.[0]' .exp_agent/findings_round_01.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '{keys: keys, selected_rules: (.selected_rules|length), consulted_specs: (.consulted_specs|keys|length), entity_repairs: (.entity_repairs|length), unresolved_external: .unresolved_external}' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"
/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq 'keys' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json && jq '.entity_repairs[0]' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '(.entity_repairs) |= map(. as "'$repair | {rule: $repair.rule, relative_path: $repair.relative_path, locations: $repair.locations, entities: $repair.owning_entities, invariants: $repair.applicable_invariants, evidence: $repair.repository_evidence, transformation: $repair.transformation, status: $repair.status})'"' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json > /tmp/round_completion_01.fixed.json"
/usr/bin/bash -lc 'mv /tmp/round_completion_01.fixed.json .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json'
/usr/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short'

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '(.entity_repairs | length) as "'$n | {records:$n, bad_schema: [.[] | select((.status != "repaired") or ((.entities|type)!="array") or ((.invariants|type)!="array") or ((.evidence|type)!="array") or ((.entities|length)==0) or ((.invariants|length)==0) or ((.evidence|length)==0) or ((.locations|length)==0) or (.rule == "") or (.relative_path == "") or (.transformation == ""))] | length, old_keys: ([.entity_repairs[] | keys[]] | map(select(. == "owning_entities" or . == "applicable_invariants" or . == "repository_evidence")) | unique)}'"' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"
/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '.entity_repairs[0]' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"
/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '{selected_rules, consulted_specs, schema_version, unresolved_external}' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"
/usr/bin/bash -lc 'find . -maxdepth 3 -name .git -type d -print'
/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '.rules[0]' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq 'reduce .entity_repairs[] as "'$r ({records:0,bad:[],old_keys:[]}; .records += 1 | if (($r.status != "repaired") or (($r.entities|type)!="array") or (($r.invariants|type)!="array") or (($r.evidence|type)!="array") or (($r.locations|type)!="array") or (($r.entities|length)==0) or (($r.invariants|length)==0) or (($r.evidence|length)==0) or (($r.locations|length)==0) or ($r.rule == "") or ($r.relative_path == "") or ($r.transformation == "")) then .bad += [$r] else . end | .old_keys += ([$r|keys[]|select(. == "owning_entities" or . == "applicable_invariants" or . == "repository_evidence")])) | .old_keys |= unique | .bad_count = (.bad|length) | del(.bad)'"' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -n --slurpfile p .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json --slurpfile c .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json 'def planned: ["'$p[0].rules[] as $r | $r.files[] | {rule:$r.rule, relative_path:.relative_path, locations:.locations}] | sort_by(tojson); def reported: [$c[0].entity_repairs[] | {rule, relative_path, locations}] | sort_by(tojson); (planned()) as $p1 | (reported()) as $c1 | {planned_groups:($p1|length), reported_groups:($c1|length), missing:[$p1[] | select(($c1|index(.)) == null)], extra:[$c1[] | select(($p1|index(.)) == null)]}'"' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"
/usr/bin/bash -lc 'find /workspace -maxdepth 4 -type d -name .git -print'
/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '.total_alerts, .required_rule_count, .required_rule_file_groups, ([.rules[].files[]] | length)' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -n --slurpfile p .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json --slurpfile c .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json 'def planned: ["'$p[0].rules[] as $r | $r.files[] | {rule:$r.rule, relative_path:.relative_path, locations:.locations}] | sort_by(tojson); def reported: [$c[0].entity_repairs[] | {rule, relative_path, locations}] | sort_by(tojson); planned as $p1 | reported as $c1 | ($p1 | map(tojson)) as $ps | ($c1 | map(tojson)) as $cs | {planned_groups:($p1|length), reported_groups:($c1|length), missing:[$p1[] | tojson as $x | select(($cs | index($x)) == null)], extra:[$c1[] | tojson as $x | select(($ps | index($x)) == null)]}'"' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -n --slurpfile p .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json --slurpfile c .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json 'def unique_sorted: unique | sort; ("'$p[0].rules | map(.rule) | unique_sorted) as $pr | ($c[0].selected_rules | unique_sorted) as $cr | ([ $p[0].rules[] | {rule, specs: ([.semantic_spec.core_spec_path] + [.semantic_spec.families[].spec_path])} ]) as $expected | ([ $c[0].consulted_specs | to_entries[] | {rule:.key, specs:.value} ]) as $actual | {selected_rules_match:($pr == $cr), selected_rules_expected:$pr, selected_rules_actual:$cr, spec_mismatches:[$expected[] as $e | ($actual[] | select(.rule == $e.rule)) as $a | select(($a.specs != $e.specs)) | {rule:$e.rule, expected:$e.specs, actual:$a.specs}], repaired_status_counts:($c[0].entity_repairs | group_by(.status) | map({status:.[0].status,count:length})), unresolved_external:$c[0].unresolved_external}'"' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"
